name: chat-feed
title: Chat feed
description: The conversation: the person's messages with their chips, the agent's words (interim, then the reply), a change chip for each board write, approval cards settled in place and system lines; under it one quiet status line while the agent works. Tools never show raw (PLAN ruling 6).

files.core: feed-core.ts (applyEvent, applyEvents, EMPTY_CHAT, ChatState, FeedEntry, activityLine, changeLabel; no DOM)

attributes.data-busy: true while a turn runs (set by show)

methods.configure(o): render (the host's Markdown renderer), boardName (a board's title for change chips), empty, label, clock
methods.show(state): draws the state from the core: adds and redraws only new or changed entries (an unchanged entry is the same object), keeps the view at the bottom when it was there, ticks open approvals every second
methods.answerFailed(approvalId, message): the answer did not go through: its card says why and takes clicks again

events: chat-change (bubbles): detail { board, cards, head? }, a change chip clicked; the host shows the cards
whenToUse: The words of one chat session, beside the board or in another host.
whenNotToUse: The board's own history (the ledger), or anything a tool returned raw.
accessibility: The log is role=log, polite, named 'Conversation' and focusable so it scrolls by keyboard. Each message starts with a hidden 'You:' or 'Agent:'. The status line is role=status, outside the log. Change chips are buttons.
